hypothesis: The full-range-to-Manny constraint remapping is a causal active-standing distortion; bypassing only MapProtoPolicyTargetToMannyConstraintRange while retaining AdaptParentRelativeTarget safety projection will strictly improve the locked standing verdict.
supporting_runtime_evidence_before_exper: E3 measured a 27.156594-degree mean lower-body range-mapping delta and a 47.093262-degree maximum at foot_l.
The controlled target physical plant can stand under the same fully simulated topology.
E12 explained E4's launch-mode confound and established exact Mode-A and active-standing input hashes for a controlled rerun.
competing_explanations: The range mapper is required to translate ProtoMotions full-range targets into Manny's authored constraint ranges; bypassing it will increase safety projection and worsen behavior.
The remaining failure originates earlier in policy action decoding, neutral/frame semantics, or another adapter stage rather than in the existence of range mapping.
expected_if_hypothesis_correct: With exact pre-intervention equivalence, the bypassed arm strictly shrinks the locked failed-criteria set without any new failure.
falsification_observation: With exact pre-intervention equivalence and verified bypass, the failure set is unchanged or worse, gains a new failure, or safety projection absorbs the unremapped targets without a verdict improvement.

locked_judges.success_rule: The failed-criteria set strictly shrinks without a new failed criterion.
locked_judges.failure_rule: With a valid intervention and exact pre-intervention equivalence, the failed-criteria set is unchanged, expands, or gains a new failure.

baseline.name: remap_enabled
baseline.configuration: Clean preregistration commit; locked v2 protocol; RealOnnxPolicy; 1/60 s; 10 s; unchanged seed and initial pose; no perturbation; action-semantic, provenance, and chronology diagnostics on; range-remap bypass flag omitted.

experimental.name: remap_bypassed
experimental.configuration: Identical clean commit, binary, model, protocol, timestep, window, seed, pose, perturbation, evaluator, and diagnostics; only -PhysAnimExperimentalConstraintRangeRemapBypass was added.

conclusion.summary: With exact Mode-A and active-standing pre-intervention identity, bypassing the constraint-range mapper removed its measured delta but forced the retained safety projection to absorb much larger rotations. The locked failure count expanded from three to six and every affected stability metric worsened while target readback remained exact.
conclusion.what_was_learned: The range mapper is protective and necessary under the current Manny constraint pipeline; removing it is not a path to standing. This does not prove that the current mapper is the authoritative ProtoMotions transform. The remaining high-information uncertainty is upstream action decoding, neutral/frame semantics, and whether normalized checkpoint actions are converted according to the training-time map_actions_to_pd_range contract before Manny adaptation.

cleanup.retain: Action-semantic stage trace, target publication/readback diagnostics, and general constraint adapter contracts.
